review.scope: Additive independent source, successful-receipt, transitive-import and axiom review of the two exact finite joins. The original base review remains unchanged.
findings: For every root in the complete 324-cell initialGrid, the explicit deduplicated orbit is a list permutation of the points reached after three rounds of the three declared generators. The checked finite chunk concatenation is used to cover every initial-grid member; no representative is silently omitted.

The theorem is bounded three-round reachability/equality, rather than an abstract theorem asserting stability under all further generator iterations. Bounded reachability is sufficient for the requested composition join and does not introduce a mathematical blocker.

All 102 tree-record root tuples, canonicalized modulo 6, equal the representative-root table in exact order. This is stronger than merely matching the two lengths and closes the missing checked table join.

All 15 new declarations have axiom audits: two axiom-free, thirteen with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Both successful saved snapshots, objects, JOB/RESULT and logs match the author record; four recursively resolved custom imports match successful source snapshots.
The original 38,421 closed leaves, inclusive midpoint faces and cyclic depth mod 4 split semantics are unchanged. No finite data was regenerated by this review.
remaining_physical_obligations: Realize the three finite generators on the actual physical carrier/quartet and transport the relevant physical predicates, sign/orientation and target exclusions.

Bind integer roots and path refinements to the exact pi/6-scaled physical phase boxes with all boundary conventions. The native side-chart four coordinates must not be silently identified with the separate general northwest four-entry radian chart.
Prove terminal-kind rejection and interval/Taylor/rounding semantics and bind current numerical evidence to those predicates.
Prove the actual strict-D0/full physical case cover; generic closed-box geometry alone is not that cover.
